title: Collocations
content:
Definition

Collocations woh combinations hain jahan do ya zyada words naturally saath use hote hain. Inko alag-alag use karna galat nahi hota, lekin native speakers inhe particular combinations mein use karte hain taaki sentence natural lage.

Types of Collocations

  • Verb + Noun: make a mistake, do homework
  • Adjective + Noun: strong coffee, heavy rain
  • Noun + Noun: a round of applause, a piece of advice
  • Adverb + Adjective: deeply disappointed, highly successful
  • Verb + Adverb: apologize sincerely, speak fluently

Importance

Collocations English ko natural aur fluent banate hain. Inko use karne se aapki English bookish nahi lagti.

Example: We say make a decision ✅ not do a decision ❌

Tips to Remember

  • Common patterns yaad karo (make a, do the, have a)
  • English reading aur listening se collocations observe karo
  • Apne daily sentences mein use karo
